text: Kaufland is one of the two retail companies of the Schwarz Group, alongside Lidl.
short: Kaufland is a Schwarz Group retail company

source.name: Schwarz Group: Who We Are (gruppe.schwarz)
source.quote: Lidl and Kaufland form the pillars of the food retail market and are an integral part of their customers’ daily lives in 33 countries.
source.note: Undated corporate page of the Schwarz Group describing its companies ('The companies of Schwarz Group are all perfectly in sync'); Kaufland is listed under its 'Business Areas' next to Lidl, Schwarz Produktion, PreZero and Schwarz Digits. Date is the day the page was opened.
